name: claude-code-mods-zh
description: 人工筛选、已验证、锁定版本的 Claude Code 模组（函数钩子插件），添加一次即可安装。

plugins.name: fm
plugins.description: The sailboat working animation and a conversation-only transcript, sharing a calm-mode preference across sessions.

plugins.name: terminal-browser
plugins.description: A browser inside Claude Code: preview sites and HTML, and let the agent drive the built-in browser.

plugins.name: pebrel-prompt-suggestions
plugins.description: Native empty-composer prompt predictions through the Pebrel session bridge.

plugins.name: token-optimizer
plugins.description: A token-optimizer status bar that shows where tokens go and how to spend less.

plugins.name: lcu-approve
plugins.description: Per-app approval for computer use: allow this conversation, always allow, or deny, plus a panel of approved apps.

plugins.name: fast-jev-compaction
plugins.description: Verbatim Jev-guided compaction for Claude Code sessions.

plugins.name: lot-map
plugins.description: A live map beside the chat: memory, files, shell, web, model, agents, skills and hooks light up as they are used.

plugins.name: council
plugins.description: Consult several AI agents at once for diverse perspectives, with a streaming pane and an optional heads-up side check.

plugins.name: codex-attachment-manager
plugins.description: Sends earlier images as short placeholders and fetches originals back by ID, so long image sessions keep the prompt cache.

plugins.name: storybloq
plugins.description: Project memory: tickets, issues, handovers and lessons kept in a .story/ folder in your repo.

plugins.name: shared-session
plugins.description: Share a session with a link or your team; teammates join from their own Claude Code and watch every turn live.

plugins.name: just-do-it
plugins.description: Continues authorized work through verification and delivery, and surfaces setup issues to repair.

plugins.name: prismantis
plugins.description: Colorful, themeable rendering for replies: tables, headings, code, numbers, paths and links.

plugins.name: filetree
plugins.description: An IDE-style file tree that shows what Claude is doing and where in your files.

plugins.name: jev-auto-compact
plugins.description: At 60% context, prunes stale tool calls with zero generation; skips instead of falling back to an LLM summary.

plugins.name: cache-tax
plugins.description: Keeps the one-hour prompt cache warm during breaks, asking before a cold send and showing the rewrite cost.

plugins.name: turbo
plugins.description: A human-gated agentic software factory: you decide what to build and judge the result, skills build and ship it.

plugins.name: agent-standup-band
plugins.description: A line above the prompt when another local session needs you, and a toast when one finishes.

plugins.name: flightdeck
plugins.description: A live agent dashboard: model vitals, an on-call architect, permission checks, subagent cards and a session log.

plugins.name: caliber-jev-compaction
plugins.description: Verbatim Jev-guided compaction for Claude Code sessions.

plugins.name: mazyos
plugins.description: A Portuguese business OS plugin: your company memory in every session, brand identity on outputs, and 17 marketing/SEO skills.

plugins.name: start
plugins.description: Workflow orchestration commands for agentic software development.

plugins.name: shunt
plugins.description: A usage band for the shunt gateway: each window's spend and reset time, plus a full /shunt:usage breakdown.

plugins.name: operator
plugins.description: Durable project and user memory for agent-driven development.

plugins.name: carbon
plugins.description: Tracks the carbon footprint of your Claude Code sessions in the terminal and desktop app.

plugins.name: agentctl
plugins.description: An agent control plane for a session: task scope, evidence and hand-over.

plugins.name: multi-core
plugins.description: Use ChatGPT, Cursor, OpenCode and Antigravity models inside one session, switching with /model.

plugins.name: work-mode
plugins.description: Session modes: auto (no mid-task questions), out (delegate batch work) and wrap (converge and finish).

plugins.name: tokendoctor
plugins.description: Replays your past sessions to show what each change would have saved, then applies only what you pick.

plugins.name: engineer
plugins.description: A disciplined agentic-engineering methodology kit: intake, AC discovery, spec, planning, implementation, verification, hardening.

plugins.name: skins
plugins.description: Skins and fifteen themes for the transcript, with rich cards and a usage band; /skin swaps them live.

plugins.name: show-your-work
plugins.description: Shows finished work in the terminal: screenshots, click-through videos and synced before/after QA.

plugins.name: jevmem-pane
plugins.description: A side pane showing what jevmem recalled, what its guard decided and what the last turn saved.

plugins.name: ctx-handoff
plugins.description: Turns what you teach Claude into project notes, catches common slips, keeps the cache warm and resumes long sessions.

plugins.name: inbox
plugins.description: Gathers the questions, tasks, findings and PRs waiting on you in a session.

plugins.name: lane-stack
plugins.description: A solo PM conveyor: orchestrator agents, lane playbooks, onboard and resume commands.

plugins.name: compact-adviser
plugins.description: Suggests or runs /compact at a completed checkpoint, judged by TypeSafe Jev.

plugins.name: ripple
plugins.description: Picks reasoning effort per prompt and a worker per delegated task, keeps the cache warm and shows where each request went.

plugins.name: tavernweave-agent-skills
plugins.description: 23 shared skills for rolecards, software work and bounded cloud tasks, plus a Soul mode switch above the prompt.

plugins.name: agent-usage-guard
plugins.description: Holds subagent fan-out, heavy-context prompts and retry loops before they spend your usage window.
